harness.kind: headless Chrome 155 via Playwright channel 'chrome' (--enable-unsafe-webgpu), apple metal-3, M3 Max; one fresh page per run
harness.why: This session was open in no desktop-app window, so the in-app browser pane was hidden (the page still reported 'visible'). The method forbids timing from a hidden pane.
harness.inPaneCrossCheck: One hidden-pane ring run gave 10.55 ms against headless 10.30/10.29 ms, the same regime.
harness.scripts: Session scratchpad bench.mjs (demo console BENCH/REGRESSION lines), ref.mjs (bench3d tier checkboxes + #run), ab.sh (swap exported WGSL trees between runs). Playwright left node alive ~10 min after browser.close(); process.exit(0) fixes it.

contention: Unreal Editor (ArenaShooter) ran all session at 10-15% CPU.
From ~02:00Z another session's work raised absolute times ~1.2 ms on gables; only interleaved comparisons are used from then on.
From ~03:15 local a second Unreal Editor (vibe-land) and other GPU clients pushed ring to 10.96-17.48 ms; nothing after that point is used for decisions.

8ew_flagsOnlyNeighbourLoads.finding: As in 8dx, Metal already drops unused fields of whole-struct loads; the csr_sort cost is the random neighbour lines themselves.

ring120FpsAssessment: Ring primal 3.87 + dual 1.75 ms are near bandwidth floors (8dx: ~30 ns per body-iteration). Collision 3.6 ms and graph 0.6 ms are at reference parity. Even removing graph entirely and a third of collision leaves ~9 ms. 8.33 ms needs a numerics change (narrower contact records or fewer iterations), which needs the user's approval.
